name: Anime Shift
description: On a neon street at night the live-action shot morphs into hand-drawn anime.

wardrobe.man: a white school-style blazer over a black t-shirt and black trousers
wardrobe.woman: a white school-style blazer over a black t-shirt and black trousers
wardrobe.person: a white school-style blazer over a black t-shirt and black trousers

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. The {subject} from the reference images is the only person in it: keep {their} exact face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline and hairstyle, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. Take only the face and hair from the references; the clothing, background and lighting are all new. The {subject} stands under an umbrella on a narrow city street at night in light rain, turned toward the camera, wearing {wardrobe}. Glowing paper lanterns and colorful neon shapes line the street, wet pavement reflects magenta and cyan light, and steam rises from a food stall. Medium shot at eye level, the {subject} centered. Cinematic night photography, neon practical lighting, soft rain streaks. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, neon reduced to abstract colored shapes and blank lanterns throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands under the umbrella on the neon street, eyes on a point just past the camera. The live-action image morphs into hand-drawn 2D anime cel animation in the modern Japanese television idiom: clean ink contours appear around everything, the shading flattens into two-tone cels, the rain becomes drawn white streaks, the neon becomes bright painted glows, and the {subject} turns into an anime character with the same face, hair and clothes, large expressive eyes, hair moving in the wind, until by the last second the whole shot is a moving anime frame. The camera pushes in slowly. Sound: soft rain, a gentle rising synth pad, a distant city hum. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, hand-drawn 2D anime cel animation, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The live-action image morphs into hand-drawn 2D anime cel animation: clean ink contours appear around everything, the shading flattens into two-tone cels, and the {subject} turns into an anime character with the same face, hair and clothes, until by the last second the whole shot is a moving anime frame. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: a gentle rising synth pad, soft ambient sound. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, hand-drawn 2D anime cel animation, sharp detail, stable picture.
